newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse ends down, unnerved by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse ends down, unnerved by Wall Street.

text.p: The Madrid bourse slid to end down on Wednesday after dealers became unnerved by profit-taking on Wall Street. Traders said stocks could post further losses in the short term.

The general index ended down 0.40 points, 0.07 pct, to 612.76, while the Ibex-35 index closed down 4.32 points, 0.06 pct, to 6,958.92. Turnover was higher than in recent sessions with more than 95 billion pesetas changing hands.
Traders said the market could remain negative on Thursday morning ahead of a public holiday in Madrid.
"The market remained positive this morning and the turnaround we saw this afternoon points to a more pronounced fall in the short term," one dealer said.
Among individual stocks, BCH outperformed the market after posting results at the top end of expectations on Tuesday.
Endesa also outperformed the market, rising 2.21 percent to 12,480 ahead of Thursday's share split.
Telefonica ended slightly higher, five pesetas up at 4,210, after suffering a steep correction since the beginning of July.
